summary: Copy-out (default tier) mutation probe; the tracked tree was never mutated, so no file lock or git-sync lease was needed. The mutant lives only in the probe's repo mirror. The --test materializes a real copy of run-git-sync.test.ts beside the mirrored mutant, but only when the mirrored test is a symlink, so the real-tree baseline runs unchanged. Materializing the copy stops Vite from realpathing the symlinked test back into the real tree and importing the real module. Mutated control: 'F6: submodule non-fast-forward retry reauthorizes before another push'. The real-tree baseline passed 1 (155 skipped) and so did the unmutated-mirror baseline. The mutant swallows a beforePush (publication authority) refusal instead of refusing the push. That let the retry push proceed after the owner key became unavailable, and the test failed: expected 2 to be 1 (the push count). The probe reported MUTANT CAUGHT and verified run-git-sync.ts byte-identical afterwards. The unmutated mirror copy passed and the mutant failed on the push-count assertion, so the mutated module was the one loaded. This regenerates binding 16317, which went stale when WI-10004413 changed run-git-sync.ts (committed d86be6ed, blob af38742a).
